versos.grego: Παρακαλῶ οὖν πρῶτον πάντων ποιεῖσθαι δεήσεις, προσευχάς, ἐντεύξεις, εὐχαριστίας, ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων,

controles.web: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks, be made for all men:
controles.kjv: I exhort therefore, that, first of all, supplications, prayers, intercessions, and giving of thanks, be made for all men;
controles.livre: Por isso eu te exorto, antes de tudo, que se façam pedidos, orações, intercessões e atos de gratidão por todas as pessoas;

versos.grego: ὑπὲρ βασιλέων καὶ πάντων τῶν ἐν ὑπεροχῇ ὄντων, ἵνα ἤρεμον καὶ ἡσύχιον βίον διάγωμεν ἐν πάσῃ εὐσεβείᾳ καὶ σεμνότητι.

controles.web: for kings and all who are in high places; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
controles.kjv: For kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.
controles.livre: pelos reis, e por todos os que estão em posição superior, para que tenhamos uma vida quieta e sossegada, em toda devoção divina e honestidade.

versos.grego: τοῦτο καλὸν καὶ ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Θεοῦ,

controles.web: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior;
controles.kjv: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Saviour;
controles.livre: Isso é bom e agradável diante de Deus nosso Salvador;

versos.grego: ὃς πάντας ἀνθρώπους θέλει σωθῆναι καὶ εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας ἐλθεῖν.

controles.web: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.
controles.kjv: Who will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth.
controles.livre: que quer que todas as pessoas se salvem e venham ao conhecimento da verdade.

versos.grego: εἷς γὰρ Θεός, εἷς καὶ μεσίτης Θεοῦ καὶ ἀνθρώπων, ἄνθρωπος Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς,

controles.web: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
controles.kjv: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus;
controles.livre: Pois há um só Deus, e um só Mediador entre Deus e os seres humanos: o humano Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: ὁ δοὺς ἑαυτὸν ἀντίλυτρον ὑπὲρ πάντων, τὸ μαρτύριον καιροῖς ἰδίοις·

controles.web: who gave himself as a ransom for all; the testimony in its own times;
controles.kjv: Who gave himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time.
controles.livre: Ele mesmo se deu como resgate por todos, como testemunho ao seu tempo.

versos.grego: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κῆρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος, ἀλήθειαν λέγω, οὐ ψεύδομαι, διδάσκαλος ἐθνῶν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀληθείᾳ.

controles.web: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle (I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying), a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.
controles.kjv: Whereunto I am ordained a preacher, and an apostle, (I speak the truth in Christ, and lie not;) a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and verity.
controles.livre: Para isso fui constituído pregador e apóstolo, instrutor dos gentios na fé e na verdade (estou dizendo a verdade , não mentindo).

versos.grego: Βούλομαι οὖν προσεύχεσθαι τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ ἐπαίροντας ὁσίους χεῖρας χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ διαλογισμοῦ.

controles.web: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
controles.kjv: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
controles.livre: Portanto, quero que os homens orem em todo lugar, levantando mãos santas, sem ira nem briga.

versos.grego: Ὡσαύτως γυναῖκας ἐν καταστολῇ κοσμίῳ μετὰ αἰδοῦς καὶ σωφροσύνης κοσμεῖν ἑαυτάς, μὴ ἐν πλέγμασιν καὶ χρυσίῳ ἢ μαργαρίταις ἢ ἱματισμῷ πολυτελεῖ,

controles.web: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety; not just with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing;
controles.kjv: In like manner also, that women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with shamefacedness and sobriety; not with broided hair, or gold, or pearls, or costly array;
controles.livre: De semelhante maneira, as mulheres se adornem com roupa respeitosa, com pudor e sobriedade, não com tranças, ouro, pérolas, ou roupas caras;

versos.grego: ἀλλ’ ὃ πρέπει γυναιξὶν ἐπαγγελλομέναις θεοσέβειαν, δι’ ἔργων ἀγαθῶν.

controles.web: but (which becomes women professing godliness) with good works.
controles.kjv: But (which becometh women professing godliness) with good works.
controles.livre: mas sim, com boas obras, como é adequado às mulheres que declaram reverência a Deus.

versos.grego: Γυνὴ ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ μανθανέτω ἐν πάσῃ ὑποταγῇ·

controles.web: Let a woman learn in quietness with all subjection.
controles.kjv: Let the woman learn in silence with all subjection.
controles.livre: A mulher aprenda quietamente, com toda submissão.

versos.grego: διδάσκειν δὲ γυναικὶ οὐκ ἐπιτρέπω, οὐδὲ αὐθεντεῖν ἀνδρός, ἀλλ’ εἶναι ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ.

controles.web: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.
controles.kjv: But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence.
controles.livre: Porém não permito que a mulher ensine, nem use de autoridade sobre o marido,  mas sim, que esteja em silêncio.

versos.grego: Ἀδὰμ γὰρ πρῶτος ἐπλάσθη, εἶτα Εὔα.

controles.web: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
controles.kjv: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.
controles.livre: Pois primeiro foi formado Adão, depois Eva.

versos.grego: καὶ Ἀδὰμ οὐκ ἠπατήθη, ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἐξαπατηθεῖσα ἐν παραβάσει γέγονεν·

controles.web: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;
controles.kjv: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.
controles.livre: E Adão não foi enganado; mas a mulher foi enganada, e caiu em transgressão.

versos.grego: σωθήσεται δὲ διὰ τῆς τεκνογονίας, ἐὰν μείνωσιν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ καὶ ἁγιασμῷ μετὰ σωφροσύνης.

controles.web: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and sanctification with sobriety.
controles.kjv: Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.
controles.livre: Porém ela se salvará tendo parto,  se permanecerem na fé, amor, e santificação com sobriedade.
